subject: Authentication & Authorization evidence request (BrightLeaf Health)
messages:
From: Elena Cruz <elena.cruz@brightleafhealth.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: Matt O'Neill <matt.oneill@brightleafhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Aug 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Authentication & Authorization evidence for SOC 2 / SIG

Hi Karthik,

We're kicking off BrightLeaf's SOC 2 readiness and the audit team requested a focused packet of IAM / access control evidence (SIG/CAIQ items mapped to our controls). Can Redwood provide the following artifacts for review? If some items are covered by a different dataset, point me at that instead.

- SAML/SSO: current IdP metadata (XML), example raw SAML assertions for 5 anonymized users covering login events across 30 days (redacted PII ok), and any mapping notes for SAML attributes to internal user roles.
- SCIM: delta sync log for the past 30 days (sample), plus a short description of provisioning flow and fallback behavior.
- RBAC / least-privilege: current role-to-permission matrix, owner list for critical roles, and a short narrative describing how least-privilege is enforced for service accounts.
- Service accounts: inventory export, approval/owner trail, and rotation policy references.
- Evidence of sampling / attestation: any recent role review artifacts or attestation logs.
- SIG/CAIQ mapping: if you have a prebuilt mapping for IAM controls (A2/A6-ish), please include or confirm equivalence.

Preferred delivery: secure SFTP or a pre-shared Drive folder (we can provide an SFTP account if that works better). Requested timeline: initial packet by 2028-09-08 if possible; full packet by 2028-09-15. Let me know if you need a narrower scope or any additional clarifying info.

Also happy to do a 30-minute call this week to align on formats and redaction.

Thanks,
Elena Cruz
Information Security Manager
BrightLeaf Health
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: Elena Cruz <elena.cruz@brightleafhealth.com>
Cc: Matt O'Neill <matt.oneill@brightleafhealth.com>, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 28 Aug 2028 10:05:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Authentication & Authorization evidence for SOC 2 / SIG

Elena — thanks for the clear list. Happy to take this on. Internal owners and plan below; sending internal asks now to kick collection off.

Planned owners / deliverables:
- Vanessa Ortiz: SAML metadata (XML) and 5 anonymized SAML assertion samples, plus mapping notes.
- Ben Carter: SCIM delta export (30d sample) and service-account inventory + owner trail.
- Karthik Iyer (me): RBAC matrix (role -> permissions), least-privilege narrative for service accounts, and SIG mapping notes for IAM controls.

Clarifications we need from you:
1) Anonymization: is redaction of usernames and emails acceptable for the SAML assertions, or do you need the original values under an NDA?
2) Delivery: please confirm SFTP credentials or provide a Drive share; we will not put raw assertions on public links.
3) Format preferences: CSV/Excel for matrices is fine; if you need specific column names call them out.

Target timings (internal): initial compiled packet (first pass) by 2028-09-05; final (with any auditor comments applied) by 2028-09-12. If BrightLeaf needs an accelerated delivery, tell us which items are highest priority and we'll prioritize those first.

I've attached an evidence-collection-checklist to follow internally. Vanessa/Ben — please confirm ETA and any blockers.

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Solutions (Security & Compliance)
Redwood Inference

First packet (target delivery 2028-09-05):

- 5 anonymized SAML assertion samples (assertions redacted to remove PII; full format preserved)

- service-accounts.csv (inventory + owner + last rotation)
- evidence-collection-checklist.pdf (notes on where each artifact maps to SIG/CAIQ controls)

We plan to place the packet in a secure Drive folder and share a link; if you prefer SFTP we can use SFTP and provide credentials. Please confirm preferred transfer method.

Link for reviewers (temporary): https://drive.redwood.example/secure/brightleaf/packet-DL-4821 (we will lock and audit access once shared). HubSpot for the request: HUBSPOT-4821.

Questions for you before we finalize the anonymized assertions: are the auditors okay with replacing emails with stable pseudonyms (user1@redacted.local) while preserving subject/session IDs? If you need original values, we'll coordinate an NDA-handshake and more restricted transfer.

If helpful, we can set up a 30-minute alignment call Thursday morning (my calendar is open 9–11am PT).
